name: Camping Hopfensee
beschreibung:
=== beschreibung ===

The Camping Hopfensee campsite is located at Hopfensee in Füssen, Tirol, Austria. The area is characterized by the Ammergauer Alps and the Alpenvorland (Alpine foothills). In summer, the surrounding hiking trails in the mountains are a key attraction. In winter, guests can access the ski resorts of the Zugspitze and the Tannheimer Tal. The site is divided into a wooded and a grassland area. Facilities include sanitary amenities, electric hookups, and direct access to the lake. Visitors can arrive by mobile homes, travel trailers, or tents. The atmosphere on the campsite is peaceful and family-friendly.
